description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements multiple interfaces related to a SQLite-backed key-value store, including cache, inspection, and limit management. It includes methods for database initialization, integrity checks, backup, CRUD operations, and notification handling within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing a SQLite-based key-value store with cache, inspection, and limit functionalities, supporting notifications and database integrity management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes the temporary journal file directory corruption.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs a database integrity check and marks the database as corrupt if needed.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the SQLite database, creates necessary tables and triggers, and applies database constraints.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the SQLite database connection.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if the system time is synchronized, optionally using system manager services.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for store events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store with optional TTL, notifying subscribers.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes the SQLite cache.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespace names.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves sizes of stored namespaces.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Logs SQLite errors.
